ModMetaData.name: Yobai: Simple Harem Management
ModMetaData.author: Xylthixlm
ModMetaData.description: Tired of manually swapping around beds so everyone in your harem gets lovin'? Don't like the idea of installing a harem bed that holds 8 people? This mod makes it so that harem members will automatically swap around beds so everyone gets a turn. Don't want to build a harem bedroom? Spouses and lovers will get up and borrow an empty spot in a double bed to get some lovin' instead.
